method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Constructs the inventory menu's weapon, inventory/ammo/attachments, health, gear, storage, equipment, resources, status and armor-plate views plus PC-specific/fake elements as written. Focus/model hooks update inventoryDescription and tooltips. Button and contextual providers gate drop/split/current-weapon detach actions by input type, scoreboard visibility, NONE ID and stackCount, preserving true versus nil/false returns. Open/close overrides maintain inventory.isOpen, scriptNotify consumes its matching argument then goes back, and the saved override-removal closure is retained. Final dual-weapon preferences replace selected widgets with fakes. All nested actions are deferred bindings; no inventory command success is proved.
unknowns: No actual callback delivery, cancellation-after-close, successful native mutation or service response is proved.
Recovered source defects, nil fallthroughs, repeated/replaced registrations and opaque aliases are preserved rather than repaired.
Public-reuse investigation is inherited from frozen archived-record-00026; this author performed no outside research.
